_key.description: Genomic element key, Ensembl gene ID and source file accession joined by underscores.

enum: predicted regulatory element effect on gene expression

score.title: Score
score.description: ENCODE-rE2G score: Probability that the element has a regulatory effect on the target gene.
score.threshold: Upstream model-specific score thresholds define the published thresholded links; the adapter applies no additional score filter. ENCODE-rE2G thresholds at 70% recall are: extended 0.336, dhs_h3k27ac_megamap 0.217, dhs_megamap 0.201, atac_megamap 0.179, atac_intact_hic 0.232, dhs_intact_hic 0.243, atac_h3k27ac_megamap 0.203, and atac_h3k27ac_intact_hic 0.259. Scores above the applicable threshold are called links. Use the source file/model version to select the threshold; there is no universal cutoff and this list is not exhaustive.
